editions.name: TiddlyWiki Forge (landingswiki)
editions.description: Bilingual Forge homepage with editable ABC Jingle follow-score card, plugin library and standalone wiki download

home.headingEn: Make the Forge homepage your own
home.descriptionDa: Gem din egen kopi af forsiden, skriv velkomsten om, og prøv at ændre noderne i Forge-jinglen.
home.descriptionEn: Save your own copy of this page, rewrite the welcome message and try changing the notes in the Forge jingle.

editions.name: Graph Edition
editions.description: Graph Edition using native TW5-Graph add-node/add-edge toolbar buttons and compact contextual editing for relations and appearance.

home.headingDa: Tegn et kort over dine idéer
home.descriptionDa: Forbind personer, emner og noter på et kort. Følg en forbindelse, eller åbn en note direkte fra kortet.
home.descriptionEn: Connect people, topics and notes on a map. Follow a connection or open a note directly from the map.

editions.name: HUPedia Edition
editions.description: HUPedia: readable editable WikiText, Danish/English infoboxes and article translations using TiddlyWiki's language

home.descriptionDa: Skriv artikler med faktabokse og kilder. Knyt beslægtede emner sammen, så læseren kan gå på opdagelse.
home.descriptionEn: Write articles with fact boxes and sources. Link related topics so readers can explore one article from another.

editions.name: Tegne Edition
editions.description: Offline Excalidraw drawing studio with editable SVG scenes, SitePublisher and bilingual UI; large self-contained file; browser test pending

home.descriptionDa: Tegn en skitse eller et diagram med Excalidraw. Gem tegningen i wikien, og tegn videre, når idéen ændrer sig.
home.descriptionEn: Draw a sketch or diagram with Excalidraw. Save it in your wiki and keep drawing as the idea develops.

editions.name: Musik Edition
editions.description: ABC notation with editable score, responsive three-tab mini mixer (Voices, Accompaniment, Chords), live playback controls, TinySynth offline fallback, MuseScore import and teaching collections

home.descriptionDa: Skriv noder i ABC, eller hent dem fra MuseScore. Spil melodien, og følg noder og akkorder undervejs.
home.descriptionEn: Write a tune in ABC or import a score from MuseScore. Play it back and follow the notes and chords.

editions.name: Silba Ätno Repertoire
editions.description: 18 numre med nodebog, Music Minus One, stiknoder, stemmer og PDF-udskrift.

home.headingEn: Play from the band’s tune book
home.descriptionDa: Find en melodi fra Silba Ätnos repertoire, øv din stemme, eller bladr gennem sætlisten, mens I spiller.
home.descriptionEn: Find a tune from Silba Ätno’s repertoire, practise your part or turn through the set list as the band plays.

editions.name: Akustisk-Elektrisk Repertoire
editions.description: Four Balkan duo tunes with concert scores, capo charts, and parts for soprano and sopranino saxophone.

home.headingEn: Play Balkan music as a duo
home.descriptionDa: Spil fire melodier fra duoens repertoire med noder i klingende toneart, greb til capo og stemmer til sopran- og sopraninosax.
home.descriptionEn: Play four tunes from the duo’s repertoire with concert-pitch scores, capo chord shapes and parts for soprano and sopranino sax.

editions.name: AniMus Forge I
editions.description: Start your own animation from a blank scene or a starter template. Open complete example productions separately.

home.descriptionDa: Vælg en startscene, eller byg din egen. Giv figurerne bevægelse og replikker, og sæt musik til handlingen.
home.descriptionEn: Pick a starter scene or build your own. Bring characters to life with movement and dialogue, then add music.

editions.name: Turn Around — Beyond the Cave
editions.description: An AI-generated musical animation made with AniMus. Explore Plato’s cave, then edit the audio recordings, music, characters, camera and animation.

home.headingEn: Explore Plato’s cave as a musical
home.descriptionDa: Se den animerede forestilling, og prøv selv at ændre kamera, figurer eller musik i en scene.
home.descriptionEn: Watch the animated musical, then try changing the camera, characters or music in a scene of your choice.

editions.name: The Ship of Theseus
editions.description: A fourteen-scene musical with Mara, Pip and Ione, in Danish and English.

home.headingEn: When is it still the same ship?
home.descriptionDa: Følg Mara, Pip og Ione i en musical om Theseus’ skib. Åbn scenerne, og redigér din egen udgave.
home.descriptionEn: Follow Mara, Pip and Ione through a musical about the ship of Theseus. Open the scenes and edit your own version.

editions.name: AI Edition
editions.description: AI Forge 0.4.2 with OpenAI, Claude and Google Gemini, local LM Studio/Ollama, approved ForgeShare Vault and screenshot analysis.

home.headingDa: Arbejd med en AI i din wiki
home.headingEn: Work with AI in your wiki
home.descriptionDa: Stil spørgsmål, få hjælp til et udkast, eller tal om et billede. Vælg en onlinetjeneste eller din egen lokale model.
home.descriptionEn: Ask questions, work on a draft or discuss an image. Choose an online service or use a model on your computer.

editions.name: HUPin Edition
editions.description: Interactive pins on images and SVG; optional PasteUp and online map integrations. English UI migration pending / Klikbare billeder og SVG

home.descriptionDa: Sæt nåle på et kort eller et billede. Lad hver nål åbne en tekst om det, man ser.
home.descriptionEn: Place pins on a map or picture. Let each pin open a note about the place or detail it marks.

editions.name: TiddlyWiki + Forge Plugin Library
editions.description: Standard TiddlyWiki with Forge Plugin Library configured for installing plugins.

home.headingEn: Standard TiddlyWiki with Forge Plugin Library
home.descriptionDa: En almindelig TiddlyWiki med Forge Plugin Library tilføjet. Vælg og installer selv de plugins, du vil bruge.
home.descriptionEn: A standard TiddlyWiki with Forge Plugin Library added. Choose and install the plugins you want to use.

editions.name: CutOut Edition
editions.description: Original CutOut workshop, examples, Excalidraw drawing bridge, scenes, theatre, PasteUp and Slideshow; local export and native Dansk/English

home.headingDa: Byg en dukke af løse dele
home.descriptionDa: Tegn hoved, krop og lemmer, og sæt dem sammen til en dukke. Flyt delene, og spil en scene.
home.descriptionEn: Draw a head, body and limbs, then assemble them into a puppet. Move the pieces to act out a scene.

editions.name: Slideshow Edition
editions.description: Original Slideshow and PasteUp, seven example stories, local document import, PDF, interactive sites and editable wiki backup; native Dansk/English

home.headingEn: Tell a story in pictures and words
home.descriptionDa: Sæt billeder og tekst fra din wiki sammen til en præsentation eller plakat. Vis den på skærmen, eller gem en PDF.
home.descriptionEn: Arrange pictures and text from your wiki into a presentation or poster. Show it on screen or save a PDF.

editions.name: Shop Edition
editions.description: Nine original Shop templates, offline customer-site export and a manual Forms/Sheets, Google Sites and Funnel setup guide

home.descriptionDa: Vælg en skabelon, vis dine varer, og tilføj en bestillingsformular, så kunderne kan sende dig deres ordre.
home.descriptionEn: Choose a template, display your products and add an order form so customers can send their orders to you.

editions.name: The Stick Orchestra
editions.description: The Stick Orchestra in a separate AniMus wiki.

home.descriptionDa: Se tændstikfigurerne spille sammen, og åbn scenen for at ændre musikernes bevægelser i takt med musikken.
home.descriptionEn: Watch the stick figures play together, then open the scene to change how the musicians move to the music.

editions.name: The Tinderbox
editions.description: The Tinderbox in a separate AniMus wiki.

home.descriptionDa: Se eventyret som animeret forestilling. Åbn en scene, og prøv din egen iscenesættelse med figurer og musik.
home.descriptionEn: Watch the fairy tale as an animated show. Open a scene and try staging it yourself with characters and music.

editions.name: Greek harbour starter
editions.description: Greek harbour starter in a separate AniMus wiki.

home.headingEn: Tell a story in the harbour
home.descriptionDa: Brug den græske havn som kulisse. Vælg dine figurer, og giv dem deres første bevægelser på scenen.
home.descriptionEn: Use the Greek harbour as your backdrop. Choose your characters and give them their first movements on stage.
